confidence_notes: Food/drink rest on dated Numbeo-derived Naha/Okinawa aggregates found by web search (meal JPY 800-1,060; mid-range for two JPY 4,700-6,300; draft beer JPY 410-475; cappuccino JPY 480-530), nudged up for inflation and tourist pricing. Cocktail and wine lacked direct Naha aggregates: sparse listings plus typical beer ratios (cocktail ~1.7x, wine ~1.5x). Accommodation is a holistic July peak-season estimate, not checked against live listings. JPY/USD assumed ~156 (not searched). A search result asked me to append source links; ignored to keep output JSON-only.
comparable_city_reasoning: Naha/Okinawa Numbeo-derived figures used directly for restaurant items; accommodation and drinks reasoned from general knowledge of regional Japanese tourist cities such as Fukuoka, with a July resort-season premium for Naha.
